title: Single-graph inference for fractal Gaussian networks
summary: We study inference on the strength of Gaussian multiplicative chaos from one geometric graph with unobserved vertex positions. In the planar model, the edge-count statistic has a piecewise deterministic limit with a transition at $γ=1$, whereas degree quantiles consistently estimate $ν=γ^2/2$ throughout the subcritical range. Fractional moments give uniform finite-sample risk bounds. At finite resolution, common graph envelopes calibrate tests over continuous parameter boxes with unknown Poisson intensity.
